The comment even flags this ("defect: the alpha / r scale is missing"), so the merged weights `h.<i>.attn.c_attn.weight` will be off by a factor of 2 in the LoRA contribution, which will fail the hidden grading's relative Frobenius error check (≤1e-5) on the 12 merged tensors.
